entries.text: Polars 2 is supported and the lock moves to Polars 2.1.0. Polars-backed DataFrame runs keep the Polars version default execution engine, which is the auto engine; use --execution-engine in-memory or streaming to pin one.
Fixed the NYC Taxi DataFrame airport-trips and weekday-weekend-comparison queries failing on Polars 2, which no longer coerces integer list values to float columns in is_in.
